input_policy: questions.jsonl only; gold and review files are never read by the runner

retrieval.rank_policy: Keep law, case, Civil Act and guide channels separate. Never pool channel ranks.
retrieval.delivery_boundary: Every evidence passed to generation is archived separately from every retrieval call result.

retrieval_metrics.short_channel_rule: A channel returning fewer than k items is scored using the items actually returned; a missing required identity is a miss.
retrieval_metrics.law_component_complete: All required statutes for an item are present; denominator 30.
retrieval_metrics.full_evidence_complete: All required statutes and required other sources are present; denominator 30.

answer_metrics.claim_grading: Grade each material claim against a directly supporting evidence passage. A cross-source legal effect requires evidence that states the connection itself.

tuning_policy: Do not change model, prompt, retrieval or grading after viewing this first run and report the same HO30 as an independent holdout.
